code.description: Coupon code used at checkout to apply discounts.

amount.description: Discount amount as a fixed value or percentage.

date_created.description: Date and time the coupon was created, in the site's timezone.

date_created_gmt.description: Date and time the coupon was created, in GMT.

date_modified.description: Date and time the coupon was last modified, in the site's timezone.

date_modified_gmt.description: Date and time the coupon was last modified, in GMT.

discount_type.description: Type of discount, such as percent or fixed cart discount.

description.description: Internal note or description for the coupon.

date_expires.description: Expiration date and time of the coupon, in the site's timezone.

date_expires_gmt.description: Expiration date and time of the coupon, in GMT.

usage_count.description: Number of times this coupon has been used.

individual_use.description: Whether the coupon cannot be used in conjunction with other coupons.

items.description: Product ID to which the coupon applies.

product_ids.description: List of product IDs that the coupon applies to.

items.description: Product ID excluded from the coupon discount.

excluded_product_ids.description: List of product IDs that the coupon cannot be used on.

usage_limit.description: Maximum number of times the coupon can be used across all customers.

usage_limit_per_user.description: Maximum number of times the coupon can be used by an individual customer.

limit_usage_to_x_items.description: Maximum number of qualifying individual items the coupon can be applied to.

free_shipping.description: Whether the coupon grants free shipping.

items.description: Product category ID eligible for the coupon discount.

product_categories.description: List of product category IDs that the coupon applies to.

items.description: Product category ID excluded from the coupon discount.

excluded_product_categories.description: List of product category IDs excluded from the coupon discount.

exclude_sale_items.description: Whether items already on sale are excluded from the coupon.

minimum_amount.description: Minimum order subtotal required to apply the coupon.

maximum_amount.description: Maximum order subtotal allowed when applying the coupon.

items.description: Email address allowed to redeem the coupon.

email_restrictions.description: List of customer email addresses permitted to use the coupon.

items.description: Identifier or email of a user who redeemed the coupon.

used_by.description: List of user IDs or customer emails that have redeemed the coupon.

items.description: Metadata entry containing an ID, key, and value.

meta_data.description: Custom metadata key-value pairs assigned to the coupon.

_links.description: HAL hypermedia links related to the coupon resource.

description: Details of the coupon that was deleted or moved to trash.
